id: 01_Proper Dress and PPE Lab Safety Video Part 1
title: 实验室安全（一）：着装与个人防护装备
source_doc: course/Chemical Spillage & Response/01_Proper Dress and PPE Lab Safety Video Part 1.md
author_source: project/Chemical Spillage & Response/01_Proper Dress and PPE Lab Safety Video Part 1/src.py

points.K8: 扣好实验服，袖口进手套

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着扣好的实验服、戴安全眼镜和手套，站在仪器架前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a buttoned lab coat, safety glasses and gloves, standing in front of an instrument rack and talking to the camera.
shots.narration: 安全系列第一课：着装和个人防护。

shots.scene: 俯瞰一间忙碌的实验室，几个人在各自台前工作
shots.prompt_en: A high-angle view of a busy teaching lab with several people working at different benches.
shots.narration: 先看看实验室里的日常。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研穿便装、说笑着走进实验室前厅，阿杰背着背包戴着棒球帽
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student in casual clothes walk into a lab anteroom laughing; he carries a backpack and wears a baseball cap.
shots.narration: 阿杰和小研说笑着来上实验课。

shots.scene: 两人在储物柜前停下，准备换装
shots.prompt_en: The two of them stop in front of a row of lockers, getting ready to change.
shots.narration: 进门之前，要先做好准备。

shots.scene: 实验室房间图标上方亮起黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab room icon with a yellow warning triangle above it. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室天生就有危险。

shots.scene: 老周戴护目镜和手套在分析天平前称量，小研在旁移液
shots.prompt_en: The older man in goggles and gloves weighs a sample at an analytical balance while the female graduate student pipettes nearby.
shots.narration: 风险多大，很大程度取决于你和同伴。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜旁操作培养皿，墙上挂着急救箱和灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student handles petri dishes beside a biosafety cabinet; a first aid kit and a fire blanket hang on the wall.
shots.narration: 每个人都有责任了解并遵守规则。

shots.scene: 放大镜图标扫过实验台上的几个危险图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon moves over a lab bench with small hazard pictograms on it. No people.
shots.narration: 还要能认出潜在的安全隐患。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在仪器架前，举起一件长袖衣服
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands by an instrument rack and holds up a long-sleeved shirt.
shots.narration: 第一件事，是穿对衣服。

shots.scene: 一滴液体溅向裸露手臂，皮肤图标出现红色警示
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a liquid drop splashing onto a bare forearm, with a red warning mark on the skin. No people.
shots.narration: 穿得对，能防止严重甚至致命的伤害。

shots.scene: 小研穿长袖长裤，衣物遮住全身
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in long sleeves and long pants that cover her whole body.
shots.narration: 最好的预防，是让衣物遮住全身。

shots.scene: 短裤和凉鞋图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of shorts and open sandals crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 短裤和凉鞋，会让皮肤露在外面。

shots.scene: 穿长裤和包脚鞋的双腿走过走廊，低机位
shots.prompt_en: A low-angle shot of legs in long jeans and closed-toe shoes walking down a hallway.
shots.narration: 要穿长裤和不露脚趾的鞋。

shots.scene: 小研把手提包放进储物柜，手上还戴着戒指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts her handbag into a locker; a ring is still on her finger.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，摘下首饰。

shots.scene: 小研把长发扎成马尾，穿上实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties her long hair into a ponytail and puts on a lab coat.
shots.narration: 长头发要束起来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在仪器架前出镜，摆手示意
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands by the instrument rack and waves a hand as if saying no.
shots.narration: 只把需要的东西带进实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰把背包和棒球帽放进储物柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his backpack and baseball cap into a locker.
shots.narration: 背包、钱包、外套都留在外面。

shots.scene: 沾上污渍的背包图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a backpack with a chemical stain on it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 免得它们被污染。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现实验服、眼镜、手套三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three floating icons: a lab coat, safety glasses and gloves.
shots.narration: 再来看个人防护用品。

shots.scene: 小研在实验室里穿上实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a lab coat in the lab.
shots.narration: 一般实验，实验服、眼镜和手套都必需。

shots.section_title: 扣好实验服，袖口进手套
shots.scene: 小研把实验服纽扣一颗颗扣好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student buttons her lab coat all the way up.
shots.narration: 实验服一定要扣好。
overlay: 扣好实验服，袖口进手套

shots.section_title: 扣好实验服，袖口进手套
shots.scene: 阿杰坐在台前，把手套口拉过实验服袖口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a bench and pulls his glove cuffs over the sleeves of his lab coat.
shots.narration: 袖口尽量塞进手套里。

shots.scene: 老周在挂钩前系上蓝色化学防护围裙
shots.prompt_en: The older man ties a blue chemical-resistant apron over his lab coat in front of a row of coat hooks.
shots.narration: 有喷溅，或用挥发、活泼溶液，加围裙。

shots.scene: 欣欣指了指自己的安全眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the safety glasses on its face.
shots.narration: 安全眼镜能挡住飞来的碎屑。

shots.scene: 小研戴安全眼镜的正面特写，液滴从侧面溅来被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the female graduate student in safety glasses; an icon of liquid splashing from the side is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 可它挡不住液体喷溅。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上密封式护目镜的正面特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the young male student wearing sealed chemical splash goggles.
shots.narration: 有喷溅危险，要戴耐化学品护目镜。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起戴手套的双手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises both gloved hands toward the camera.
shots.narration: 在实验室里，手套要始终戴着。

shots.scene: 小研在挂衣处戴手套，墙上一排空白手套盒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls on gloves by the coat hooks, next to a wall rack of blank glove boxes.
shots.narration: 选最合适的类型。

shots.scene: 手套图标旁对照一张空白的耐受性表格
shots.prompt_en: A glove icon next to a blank chemical resistance chart with check marks and crosses. No people.
shots.narration: 就是能耐受所用化学品的手套。

shots.scene: 液滴慢慢渗进手套的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram of a glove with a chemical drop slowly seeping through over a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 手套不吸液，但化学品会慢慢渗透。

shots.scene: 小研在洗眼器旁的水槽边脱下手套、换新手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her gloves at a sink beside an eyewash station and takes a fresh pair.
shots.narration: 所以要勤换手套。

shots.scene: 流水下用洗手液洗手
shots.prompt_en: Hands are washed with soap under running water at a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 也要勤洗手，碰过化学品后更要洗。

shots.scene: 蓝色长款低温手套特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a pair of long blue insulated cryogenic gloves.
shots.narration: 极热或极冷的东西，戴隔热手套。

shots.scene: 戴黄色隔热手套的手打开台式高压灭菌器的盖子
shots.prompt_en: Hands in yellow heat-resistant gloves open the lid of a benchtop autoclave. No faces.
shots.narration: 比如用高压灭菌器。

shots.scene: 戴蓝色手套的手从结霜的超低温冰箱里取物
shots.prompt_en: Hands in blue insulated gloves take a box out of a frosty ultra-low freezer. No faces.
shots.narration: 或者拿取干冰。

shots.scene: 防刺穿手套和锐器盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a puncture-resistant glove next to a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 处理锐器，戴防刺穿手套。

shots.scene: 烧杯飘出蒸汽线，旁有黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A beaker giving off wavy vapor lines with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有些化学品会产生危险蒸气。

shots.scene: 老周戴上带双侧滤毒盒的半面罩呼吸器，拉紧头带
shots.prompt_en: The older man puts on a half-face respirator with two filter cartridges and tightens the head straps.
shots.narration: 呼吸器可以防护你。

shots.scene: 空白培训证书图标旁有一枚法规印章图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank training certificate next to a legal seal icon. No people.
shots.narration: 但按美国法规，必须先完成培训。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周询问，老周点头指向空白培训通知
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man, who nods and points at a blank training notice.
shots.narration: 培训的事，问实验室负责人或老师。

shots.scene: 阿杰解开实验服纽扣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student unbuttons his lab coat.
shots.narration: 离开实验室前，脱下防护用品。

shots.scene: 流水洗手，摘下的安全眼镜放回挂架
shots.prompt_en: Hands washed under running water, then a pair of safety glasses placed back on a wall rack. No faces.
shots.narration: 洗手后，再进入公共区域。

shots.scene: 欣欣在仪器架前出镜，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands by the instrument rack and shakes its head.
shots.narration: 戴着手套到处摸，会扩散污染。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手去按电灯开关、拧门把手、拿电话，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons of a gloved hand touching a light switch, a door handle and a telephone, all crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 开关、门把手，甚至电话都别碰。

shots.scene: 门把手上的化学和生物污点向四周扩散
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a door handle with chemical and biohazard stains spreading to other objects around it. No people.
shots.narration: 化学和生物污染就这样被带出去。

shots.scene: 欣欣穿戴整齐，身旁出现盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, fully dressed in lab coat, glasses and gloves, stands beside a shield icon.
shots.narration: 穿对戴好，暴露和受伤风险最低。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向墙上的洗眼器和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 但光靠它们不够，下一课讲安全设备。

shots.scene: 长裤、包脚鞋、束发、无首饰四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: long pants, closed-toe shoes, tied-back hair and bare hands without jewelry. No people.
shots.narration: 长裤包脚鞋，束发摘首饰。

shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套、围裙图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a buttoned lab coat, splash goggles, gloves and an apron. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服扣好，眼镜手套选对。

shots.scene: 隔热手套和呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an insulated glove and a respirator with a training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 冷热锐器换专用手套，呼吸器先培训。

shots.scene: 洗手和门把手打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of hands washing under a tap and a gloved hand on a door handle crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 离开前脱防护、洗手，手套不出门。

shots.scene: 欣欣穿戴整齐，在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, wearing a lab coat and safety glasses, waves goodbye at the lab door.
shots.narration: 穿对戴好，安全实验，下次见！
